conviction_note: The findings sum to +0.40: a likely revenue print near the top of a range the company already guided, a FY2026 PSU payout of about 105% of target fixed by the committee on 2026-11-05, and a short at 10.6% of shares outstanding with 6.65 days to cover, against the one line that decides the stock, the Q1/FY2027 guide, where memory and now broader component inflation (TrendForce DRAM +10-20% QoQ in 4Q26; Logitech on 2026-10-27 saying pressure has spread 'to basically all electrical components') argue for a guide at or below the July framing. The scaled number is near zero (p_up 51 on a 9-point absolute move) because the last print beat the high end of its guide and still fell 17.6% on the forward margin, so the reaction function vetoes the positive fundamental read.
bar: Q4 FY2026 (14-week quarter ended 2026-10-03) revenue consensus $340.3M, two sources agreeing: Investing.com preview 2026-11-10 (https://ng.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/sonos-faces-earnings-test-as-loss-looms-after-strong-q3-93CH-2797537, GAAP EPS -$0.18, estimates flat over 60 days, mean PT $18.63) and the Benzinga estimates page via search (non-GAAP EPS $0.01, revenue $340.3M). Company guide from the Q3 call 2026-07-29 (https://s22.q4cdn.com/672173472/files/doc_financials/2026/q3/SONO-3Q26-Earnings-Transcript.pdf): revenue $325-355M including ~$24M from the 53rd week, GAAP GM 39-41% (non-GAAP ~120bp higher) with a $35M / ~1,000bp memory headwind, GAAP opex $160-170M, adj. EBITDA -$11M to +$18M ($3M midpoint), FY2026 adj. EBITDA ~$181M. FY2027 colour already given: GM at roughly the low end of the Q4 range (Morgan Stanley read it as ~40% non-GAAP), first half lower, flattish opex, mitigation worth ~500bp annualised phasing in. There is no published consensus for Q1 FY2027 or FY2027 that I could source.
positioning_check: Short interest 12,539,614 shares at the 2026-10-15 settlement, 10.6% of 118.29M shares outstanding (more of the float, since Coliseum holds 15.3%), 6.65 days to cover. It was 14,464,055 at 2026-09-30 and 7.8M at 2026-08-14 (curvedtrading via search), so shorts nearly doubled after the July drop and eased slightly in October. Source: https://equibles.com/stocks/sono/shortinterest (read 2026-11-10; FINRA's next release is due 2026-11-10). Options: 25d skew -1.5 vol points (balanced to slightly call-bid), put/call OI 0.2, but the ATM spread is 111% of mid and total OI is only 750, so the chain says nothing. ATM IV of 115.8% on a 10-day expiry against 42% realised implies a large event premium, an unreliable ~15-18% event move. Spot $16.62: 5-day run-up +4.3%, 20-day -6.2%, 13% below the 52-week high. Coliseum's 13D (2026-08-03) shows 15.3% with a board seat (Shackelton) and reserves the right to pursue extraordinary transactions.

findings.finding: Q4 revenue likely lands in the upper half of the $325-355M guide, above the $340.3M consensus (my estimate ~$345-350M, +1-3% vs bar). Sonos has landed at or near the high end of its own range for eight straight quarters (Q3 $375M vs a $354.6M consensus). Counterparties that reported after Sonos last spoke saw solid premium consumer demand: Logitech (2026-10-27) had Americas net sales +13% 'reflecting solid business and consumer demand ahead of the holiday season' and described a K-shape where 'high-end consumers absolutely spend'. Best Buy (2026-08-27) had domestic comps +4.5% with home theater the second-largest contributor and raised its full-year comp guide. The Beam Ultra ($699) and Ace Ultra ($449) began shipping 2026-09-29, inside the last week of the 14-week quarter, so there is channel fill.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: On 2026-07-29 revenue came in near the high end of the guide (+5.8% vs consensus) and adj. EBITDA near the high end, and the stock fell 17.64% on the forward memory headwind. On 2026-05-04 the Q2 revenue beat was followed by -5.78%. On 2026-02-03 a holiday-quarter beat was followed by +6.36%. Revenue beats have not reliably been bought.
findings.why_not_priced: Consensus sits at $340.3M, the exact midpoint of the guide, and has been flat for 60 days, so the street has not marked it toward the high end despite Sonos's record of landing there and peers' firmer demand. If it were priced, estimates would have drifted above the midpoint and the stock would not sit 13% below its 52-week high going into a 53-week quarter. But this lands inside a range the company itself guided, so the market was told to expect it.
findings.independence: Best Buy Q2 FY27 (comps +4.1% enterprise, +4.5% domestic, home theater the #2 contributor, guide raised): https://pulse2.com/best-buy-comparable-sales-rise-4-1-as-company-sharply-raises-full-year-sales-and-eps-outlook/ . Sonos's own Q3 transcript ('eighth consecutive quarter of disciplined execution against our commitments'): https://s22.q4cdn.com/672173472/files/doc_financials/2026/q3/SONO-3Q26-Earnings-Transcript.pdf . Launch timing of the Ultra products: https://en.community.sonos.com/owners-cafe-228997/sonos-open-house-recap-sonos-27-beam-ultra-sonos-ace-ultra-and-everything-else-we-announced-today-6934668 . All three are proxies or the company's own track record, not a Sonos Q4 number.

findings.finding: The Q1 FY2027 (holiday quarter) and FY2027 guide carry downside risk against the July framing (FY27 GM at roughly the low end of the 39-41% Q4 range, first half lower). Since then: TrendForce on 2026-09-30/10-02 projected conventional DRAM contract prices +10-15% QoQ in 4Q26 on top of +13-18% in 3Q26, and on 2026-10-20 raised that to about +20% QoQ for 4Q26. Logitech said on 2026-10-27 that 'cost pressures and availability pressures have expanded from just memory to basically all electrical components' and guided its Q3 gross margin about 200bp lower year over year. Sonos said in July that the Q4 guide reflected 'only a small portion of the mitigation benefit' and that 'the industry dynamics driving these prices are not yet easing'. The offsets: consumer DRAM is 'rising moderately' and DDR4 spot was flat in early November (-0.09% w/w), the $699 Beam Ultra raises price per unit through a new product, and the company has a 500bp annualised mitigation plan.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The memory guide is what moved the last print: on 2026-07-29 the $35M Q4 headwind and the FY27 GM framing took the stock down 17.64% despite a beat. On 2026-05-04, when memory was first flagged, the stock fell 5.78%.
findings.why_not_priced: The broadening beyond memory to all electrical components was said by a direct consumer-electronics peer on 2026-10-27, three months after Sonos's July framing, and sell-side estimates have been flat for 60 days, so nobody re-marked Sonos's FY27 for it. If it were priced, the stock would have traded down after the Logitech call rather than rising 4.3% over the last five days, and FY27 estimates would have come down. Partly priced: the July -17.6% already absorbed the memory story, and 12.5M shares are short.
findings.independence: TrendForce/Evertiq 2026-10-02 (conventional DRAM +10-15% 4Q26): https://evertiq.com/news/2026-10-02-ai-keeps-memory-prices-climbing-in-q4-as-consumer-demand-weakens . Logitech transcript (component broadening, GM -200bp): https://s25.q4cdn.com/933964201/files/content_files/Logitech-Q2-FY27-Earnings-Transcript-md.pdf . Both are proxies; Sonos has not confirmed anything since 2026-07-29.

findings.finding: The compensation committee fixed FY2026 PSU attainment at about 104.6% of target on 2026-11-05, five days before the print, after the fiscal year (and Q4) had closed. Form 4s filed 2026-11-09: Casey's Nov-2024 grant earned 44,108 against a per-tranche target of 42,168 (the FY25 tranche earned 55,198, i.e. 130.9%), and Lazarus's Nov-2024 and Dec-2023 grants earned 42,824/40,941 and 37,486/35,837, both 104.6%. The FY2025 tranche metric was normalised opex as a percent of revenue (target 45.4%, actual 42.1% for 130.9%). So FY2026 landed modestly better than the plan the board set in November 2025 on opex per revenue dollar, and Q4 revenue is the denominator that remained open in July.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No history: PSU attainment has not been used as a pre-print signal on this name. The FY2025 attainment (130.9%) preceded a +1.4% reaction on 2025-11-05.
findings.why_not_priced: The attainment is only recoverable by dividing Form 4 footnote share counts by per-tranche targets in the January 2026 proxy (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1314727/000131472726000006/sono-20260112.htm); no aggregator reports it. If it were priced, it would not move anything visibly, because the FY26 E/R target itself is undisclosed and could sit anywhere relative to consensus. A 105% payout is 'slightly above plan', not a large beat, and the FY26 metric may differ from FY25's E/R ratio, so it is sized small.
findings.independence: Lazarus Form 4, same committee determination and identical 104.6% ratio: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1314727/000131472726000099/form4.xml . Same underlying event, so not independent of each other; independent of finding 1's peer data.

findings.finding: Short interest is moderately crowded into the print: 12.54M shares at 2026-10-15 (10.6% of shares outstanding, more of the float since Coliseum holds 15.3% and insiders more), 6.65 days to cover, up from 7.8M on 2026-08-14 and a 14.46M peak on 2026-09-30. Shorts built after the July memory drop, so a guide that is merely 'as framed' (FY27 GM ~39-40%) rather than worse leaves them exposed, with a 15% holder on the board who reserves the right to pursue extraordinary transactions.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Short interest was ~11M (7.1 DTC) in March 2026 and the 2026-05-04 print still fell 5.78%. A crowded short did not stop the July -17.6% (9.7M short at 2026-07-31, after the drop).
findings.why_not_priced: Positioning is not a fundamental the price discounts; it is the mechanism that amplifies an 'in line' guide. Six-plus days to cover on a name averaging 1.29M shares a day means covering cannot happen in one session without moving the price. If shorts had already covered, SI would be back near the August 7.8M.

findings.finding: Sonos said on 2026-07-29 it expects to collect the remaining $18M of IEEPA tariff refund claims, with uncertain timing, and has not booked a receivable. Receipt in Q4 would add up to ~$18M to GAAP gross profit (~500bp of GAAP GM on ~$345M revenue) and flip GAAP EPS toward breakeven against the -$0.18 GAAP consensus, while being excluded from non-GAAP figures and guidance.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 included $23.2M of refunds (GAAP GM 50.4% vs 45.5% non-GAAP), and the stock fell 17.64% anyway: the market looked straight through the refund to the guide.
findings.why_not_priced: The -$0.18 GAAP consensus appears to exclude any refund. It is a one-off with no path to the guide, since the company excludes refunds from guidance, so it is sized at a fraction.
findings.independence: none (the company's own transcript; Best Buy also reported tariff refunds muddying its Q2: https://www.tikr.com/blog/best-buys-q2-earnings-beat-on-every-metric-a-tariff-refund-muddies-the-picture)

baseline_tension: Skew is balanced (-1.5) and the chain is unusable, so the market's only directional statements are a modest 5-day bounce (+4.3%) and a short base that doubled after July. My evidence nets slightly positive on the reported quarter and slightly negative on the guide, which mostly agrees with a balanced market. The one cut against it is the crowded short against my guide negative, which is why that finding was shrunk.
lessons_applied: Lessons 1 and 6: the revenue finding lands inside the company's own guided range and this name sold its last beat (-17.6%), so it moved from +1.0 to +0.5
Lesson 2: the tariff refund is a one-off excluded from guidance and was looked through last quarter, so it moved from +0.2 to +0.1
Lesson 7: short interest of 10.6% of shares outstanding with 6.65 days to cover shrinks the guide negative, from -1.5 to -1.2
Lesson 5: the memory/component finding rests on peer and industry proxies; kept and sized small, independence says so
Left standing: the PSU attainment finding (company-level primary document, +0.5), the positioning finding (+0.5), p_up 51 and abs_move 9.0
